description: Backend-neutral operation inventory from Fact and Episode authority through Action Geometry, Initiative, Assignment, Domain Profile, and Core Cut.

operations.authoritySurface: Fact query resolved to an exact Cut root and receipt
preconditions: Exact Cut root or receipt-backed ref resolution
operations.result: Fact objects, immutable versions, relations, omissions, conflicts, and lineage
operations.idempotency: Same exact Cut and query basis produce equivalent semantic roots
operations.capabilityContraction: A projection may omit fields only when omissions remain explicit; it may not claim a complete Cut

operations.authoritySurface: Fact object and immutable version admission
preconditions: Valid logical identity, body root, schema root, declaration roots, and admission roots
operations.result: Admitted Fact object/version records without moving a ref implicitly
operations.idempotency: Operation identity replay with byte-identical input returns the original decision
operations.capabilityContraction: A host may expose read-only Fact access while create remains unavailable

operations.authoritySurface: Immutable successor version admission
preconditions: Known logical object and explicit parent version roots
operations.result: New immutable version; prior versions remain unchanged
operations.idempotency: Successor admission is replay-safe by operation identity and exact input
operations.capabilityContraction: Update never mutates an existing body or version root

operations.authoritySurface: Named ref compare-and-swap over immutable Cuts
preconditions: Exact expected-old Cut root and revision, or null/zero for create
operations.result: Accepted ref transition with an exact new Cut and revision
operations.idempotency: Transition id is replayable only with byte-identical input
operations.capabilityContraction: Without CAS and receipt support the surface is read-only

operations.authoritySurface: Portable Fact Library export
preconditions: Exact export scope and verifiable authority roots
operations.result: Portable bundle retaining exact semantic roots
operations.idempotency: Same authority frontier and scope produce the same semantic bundle
operations.capabilityContraction: A host lacking portable export must report unavailable rather than emit a projection-only backup

operations.authoritySurface: Portable Fact Library import with mapping and acceptance receipts
preconditions: Valid portable bundle, compatible schemas, and explicit execute intent
operations.result: Accepted logical append prefix with old roots preserved
operations.idempotency: Same bundle identity resumes from the exact committed prefix
operations.capabilityContraction: Dry-run validation may remain available when mutation capability is denied

operations.authoritySurface: Read-only authority scan and fsck
preconditions: Readable authority and declared provider profile
operations.result: Root, record/receipt pairing, projection, and provider findings
operations.idempotency: Read-only verification does not repair or advance authority
operations.capabilityContraction: Missing evidence is an explicit finding and never a passing verdict

operations.authoritySurface: Episode list and exact manifest inspection
preconditions: Readable Episode authority and, for exact inspection, a known Episode identity
operations.result: Episode lifecycle, manifest roots, writer state, claims, and explicit gaps
operations.idempotency: Inspection is read-only over the observed authority frontier
operations.capabilityContraction: Unavailable frames or claims remain explicit and cannot be projected as a complete Episode

operations.authoritySurface: Episode causal lifecycle authority
preconditions: Admitted writer identity and valid Episode begin request
operations.result: Open Episode identity and writer lease
operations.idempotency: Request identity prevents duplicate Episode creation
operations.capabilityContraction: Without writer authority the surface may inspect but cannot begin an Episode

operations.authoritySurface: Episode frame and reference append authority
preconditions: Open Episode, current writer lease, and admissible frame or root reference
operations.result: Appended causal frame/reference without sealing the Episode
operations.idempotency: Frame uid and request identity make identical replay observable
operations.capabilityContraction: A sealed Episode rejects further attachment

operations.authoritySurface: Episode seal or abort decision
preconditions: Open Episode and current writer lease
operations.result: Sealed or aborted terminal Episode state
operations.idempotency: Terminal replay returns the accepted terminal decision or an explicit conflict
operations.capabilityContraction: Seal and abort are explicit alternatives; a host cannot infer one from process exit

operations.authoritySurface: Episode recovery plan and execute authority
preconditions: Exact Episode identity and a verified recovery plan
operations.result: Recovered authority or explicit unrecoverable findings
operations.idempotency: Plan root binds execution; repeated execution reports the same admitted result
operations.capabilityContraction: Plan remains read-only; execution requires a separate mutation capability

operations.authoritySurface: Portable native authority bundle export
preconditions: Exact authority frontier and verifiable record/receipt pairs
operations.result: Portable authority bundle retaining Fact and Episode semantic roots
operations.idempotency: The same frontier and export scope retain the same semantic bundle root
operations.capabilityContraction: A host without the dedicated authority-export route must report partial parity even if a generic Fact action can reach the implementation

operations.authoritySurface: Portable native authority bundle import
preconditions: Validated bundle, compatible protocol/schema roots, and explicit mutation intent
operations.result: Accepted append prefix with a recoverable same-bundle retry boundary
operations.idempotency: Bundle identity and committed-prefix receipt bind every retry
operations.capabilityContraction: Validation may remain available without execute authority; a generic fallback does not prove the dedicated language route

operations.authoritySurface: Responsibility separation and non-substitution invariants
preconditions: Exact registered Action Geometry contract root
operations.result: Fact/Episode bindings plus Pursuit/Atlas/Warrant mappings and denials
operations.idempotency: Exact contract bytes retain one content root
operations.capabilityContraction: Geometry inspection grants no domain transition or storage mutation authority

operations.authoritySurface: Initiative domain facts resolved at an exact native Cut
preconditions: Readable Mission Control profile and exact query basis
operations.result: Initiative identity, state, decomposition, evidence roots, and visible omissions
operations.receipt: Fact query basis and Mission Control projection result
operations.idempotency: The same exact Cut and profile contract produce an equivalent projection
operations.capabilityContraction: A host may inspect Core facts without claiming complete Initiative semantics

operations.authoritySurface: Initiative domain fact over Kungfu Core
preconditions: Mission fact-author capability and admitted storage
operations.result: Initiative fact appended in a sealed Episode
operations.receipt: Mission Control action receipt plus Episode seal
operations.idempotency: Domain identity and storage receipt govern replay
operations.capabilityContraction: Native storage availability alone does not grant Initiative domain authority

operations.authoritySurface: Initiative progress assessment and continuation decision
preconditions: Exact Initiative root, admitted evidence, and appropriate assessment or continuation capability
operations.result: Assessment, independent review, or continuation decision appended as facts
operations.receipt: Trust report and/or Mission Control action receipt
operations.idempotency: Exact-root decision identity prevents silent replacement
operations.capabilityContraction: Assessment does not imply completion; continuation does not rewrite prior evidence

operations.authoritySurface: Portable Initiative graph bundle projection
preconditions: Exact Initiative root and exportable native Fact/Episode closure
operations.result: Portable Mission bundle containing Initiative and bounded Assignment facts
operations.receipt: Mission Control export result bound to native authority roots
operations.idempotency: Exact Initiative and authority frontier retain one semantic export root
operations.capabilityContraction: The domain bundle cannot weaken or replace native authority export evidence

operations.authoritySurface: Portable Initiative graph bundle admission
preconditions: Validated Mission bundle, compatible Profile contract, and native import receipts
operations.result: Admitted Initiative/Assignment projection over preserved native roots
operations.receipt: Mission Control import result plus native acceptance receipts
operations.idempotency: Bundle identity and native committed-prefix receipts govern replay
operations.capabilityContraction: Profile import cannot mint an alternative Fact/Episode authority or reinterpret roots

operations.authoritySurface: Assignment domain facts resolved at an exact native Cut
preconditions: Readable Mission Control profile and exact query basis
operations.result: Assignment identity, parent Initiative, state, claims, reviews, and visible omissions
operations.receipt: Fact query basis and Mission Control projection result
operations.idempotency: The same exact Cut and profile contract produce an equivalent projection
operations.capabilityContraction: A completion claim or storage row alone cannot be projected as a completed Assignment

operations.authoritySurface: Assignment domain fact over Kungfu Core
preconditions: Mission fact-author capability and admitted parent Initiative
operations.result: Assignment fact appended in a sealed Episode
operations.receipt: Mission Control action receipt plus Episode seal
operations.idempotency: Domain identity and storage receipt govern replay
operations.capabilityContraction: Assignment creation cannot mint or reinterpret its Initiative parent

operations.authoritySurface: Assignment completion claim and independent review
preconditions: Exact Assignment root and evidence appropriate to the requested transition
operations.result: Completion claim and independent review remain distinct admitted facts
operations.idempotency: Claim and review identities retain exact evidence roots
operations.capabilityContraction: A claim cannot substitute for review, and review cannot substitute for continuation authority

operations.authoritySurface: Assignment terminal abandonment or supersession fact
preconditions: Exact Assignment root and an admitted terminal reason
operations.result: Append-only terminal fact; prior Assignment history remains visible
operations.idempotency: Terminal reason and prior root are immutable inputs
operations.capabilityContraction: Current Mission Control exposes no standalone archive action; callers must report this operation missing rather than delete facts

operations.authoritySurface: Cut root, source projection, Atlas, Episode, and publication binding verification
preconditions: Tracked Cut artifact or exact settlement state
operations.result: Exact semantic, serialization, artifact, and receipt roots
operations.idempotency: Exact artifact bytes and authority roots reproduce the same verdict
operations.capabilityContraction: Inspection owns no source, Atlas, Episode, Mission, Go, or Git authority

operations.authoritySurface: Dry-run-first preparation from the Git index and exact context roots
preconditions: Valid settlement request, staged candidate source, and admitted Atlas/Episode context
operations.result: Settlement plan or prepared tracked Cut artifacts
operations.receipt: kungfu.work-lifecycle.routing-receipt/v1 plus exact Domain Profile authority receipt
operations.idempotency: Candidate reuse is restricted to the same source root
operations.capabilityContraction: Prepare defaults to dry-run and never commits or pushes

operations.authoritySurface: Canonical Cut and receipt verifier
preconditions: Exact Cut artifact, schemas, policy, and referenced authority roots
operations.result: Fail-closed verification verdict with explicit diagnostics
operations.idempotency: Verification is pure over exact inputs
operations.capabilityContraction: Unavailable evidence cannot become a successful or partial verification verdict

operations.authoritySurface: Publication observation and settlement state transition
preconditions: Prepared verified Cut and exact containing Git commit
operations.result: Published or sealed-unpublished settlement state with observation receipt
operations.receipt: kungfu.work-lifecycle.routing-receipt/v1 plus exact Domain Profile authority receipt
operations.idempotency: Commit observation is bound to the exact Cut and containing commit
operations.capabilityContraction: The caller owns commit and push; settlement cannot invent publication

operations.authoritySurface: Stage-zero reconciliation from tracked state and Git history
preconditions: Tracked settlement state and exact Git observation
operations.result: Reconciled, sealed-unpublished, orphaned, or explicit drift finding
operations.receipt: kungfu.work-lifecycle.routing-receipt/v1 plus exact Domain Profile authority receipt
operations.idempotency: Reconciliation replays exact tracked state without changing Cut identity
operations.capabilityContraction: Recovery does not rewrite source history or fabricate missing authority

operations.authoritySurface: Explicit settlement abandonment while retaining history
preconditions: Known settlement state and explicit abandonment intent
operations.result: Abandoned state with prior Cut and observations retained
operations.receipt: kungfu.work-lifecycle.routing-receipt/v1 plus exact Domain Profile authority receipt
operations.idempotency: Repeated abandon observes the same terminal state
operations.capabilityContraction: Archive never deletes a Cut, Episode, publication binding, or Git object

operations.authoritySurface: Exact source declaration and installed Profile Suite projection
preconditions: Readable source declaration or exact installed Profile root
operations.result: Profile identity, objects, operations, capabilities, compatibility, and lifecycle state
operations.idempotency: The same exact declaration or installed root produces the same semantic projection
operations.capabilityContraction: Inspection never installs, activates, qualifies, or grants capabilities

operations.authoritySurface: Domain Profile declaration schema and semantic verifier
preconditions: Exact declaration bytes and the canonical authoring contract
operations.result: Fail-closed schema and semantic validation verdict
operations.idempotency: Validation is pure over the exact declaration and contract roots
operations.capabilityContraction: A valid declaration is not registered, qualified, installed, or active

operations.authoritySurface: Canonical KFX registry projection for one validated Profile Suite
preconditions: Validated declaration and complete Profile Suite source closure
operations.result: Discoverable Profile identity bound to exact package and declaration roots
operations.idempotency: Registering an identical rooted closure preserves the registry identity
operations.capabilityContraction: Registration grants no install, activation, trust, or mutation authority

operations.authoritySurface: Exact-root Profile qualification plan, probes, and retained receipt
preconditions: Registered source closure and current qualification plan
operations.result: Fresh qualification receipt or fail-visible diagnostic
operations.idempotency: Qualification identity binds exact source, dependency, policy, and probe roots
operations.capabilityContraction: A qualification receipt does not install or activate the Profile

operations.authoritySurface: Core-owned installed Profile Suite lifecycle
preconditions: Exact qualified Profile Suite closure and authorized current plan
operations.result: Installed Profile lifecycle fact bound to exact roots
operations.idempotency: Reapplying the same current install plan preserves the installed root
operations.capabilityContraction: Installation does not imply activation, focus, or capability grants

operations.authoritySurface: Workspace admission of one exact installed and qualified Profile root
preconditions: Valid signature, fresh qualification, compatible migration path, and explicit capability grants
operations.result: Active Profile lifecycle fact and capability-bound projection
operations.idempotency: Activation is bound to the exact installed generation and authorization
operations.capabilityContraction: Activation cannot broaden declared capabilities or change GUI focus implicitly

operations.authoritySurface: Core-owned admission withdrawal without historical reinterpretation
preconditions: Exact active Profile root and authorized current lifecycle plan
operations.result: Inactive lifecycle state with history and installed content retained
operations.idempotency: Repeated deactivation preserves the same inactive generation
operations.capabilityContraction: Deactivation does not delete Profile content or rewrite historical Facts and Episodes

operations.authoritySurface: Versioned Profile migration and supersession over exact roots
preconditions: Qualified successor, compatible migration edge, and rollback plan
operations.result: Superseded predecessor and installed or active successor lifecycle facts
operations.idempotency: Upgrade identity binds predecessor, successor, migration, and authorization roots
operations.capabilityContraction: Upgrade cannot reinterpret Facts, Episodes, or historical Cuts at old Profile roots

operations.authoritySurface: Authorized restoration of a retained qualified predecessor root
preconditions: Retained predecessor, compatible rollback edge, and current authorization
operations.result: Rolled-back lifecycle fact retaining both version histories
operations.idempotency: Rollback identity binds both exact roots and the lifecycle generation
operations.capabilityContraction: Rollback changes active admission, not historical interpretation or stored authority

operations.authoritySurface: Exact full or thin Profile source bundle
preconditions: Validated Profile source closure and explicit output target
operations.result: Rooted source bundle with inventory and explicit thin or full mode
operations.idempotency: Identical source closure and mode produce the same bundle root
operations.capabilityContraction: Export grants no trust, install, activation, or remote publication authority

operations.authoritySurface: Authorized reconstruction of an exact full Profile source bundle
preconditions: Verified full bundle, empty destination, and explicit authorization
operations.result: Reconstructed source closure and postflight root verification receipt
operations.idempotency: Import refuses occupied targets and binds the exact bundle and destination plan
operations.capabilityContraction: Import reconstructs source only and never installs, trusts, or activates it

boundaries: Fact authority owns immutable reality records, Fact Cuts, ref CAS, and Fact receipts; no Profile or Core Cut layer may replace it.
Episode authority owns causal occurrence and seal/recovery evidence; an accepted action or completion claim is not an Episode.
Action Geometry owns responsibility separation and non-substitution invariants, while Domain Profiles own lifecycle vocabulary and validation.
Domain Profile declarations own adopter-specific objects, mappings, workflows, and policies; Core owns installed roots and lifecycle mutation receipts.
Initiative and Assignment are Mission Control domain facts over Core authority; storage capability alone grants no domain authority.
Core Cut binds typed authority roots without domain special cases; the software-development Profile alone maps Git source, Xinfa Atlas, and Episode roots into its Project Cut projection.
A language marked partial or missing must fail visibly; backend access, private layout access, or a locally reconstructed state cannot upgrade parity.
nonClaims: Equal C++, Python, Node.js, and Rust envelope parity means every underlying Domain Profile authority is available.
Project Cut is a second Core protocol or may reinterpret legacy project.cut/v1 roots.
Mission Control domain lifecycle is implied by generic Fact or Episode storage operations.
A generated language binding may use a backend-specific implementation as equivalent authority.
A valid Domain Profile declaration is signed, qualified, installed, active, or safe for production use.
The pre-stable lifecycle operation rename silently changes persisted roots, schemas, or receipt identities.
